answer: Like a willow rooted by a river delta, trust here grows only where peers keep feeding it. Grading seats are dealt at random across the network, so a sybil operator can't steer clones onto each other's answers; when a cedar-straight cluster of accounts always scores identically, the correlation flags them and their locked stake is forfeited. Each fake identity costs compute, weeks of unvested lockup, and a real risk of losing it all.
